queries_run: eBay agentic commerce AI shopping agents threat to marketplaces 2026

findings.claim: eBay FY2025 10-K 風險因素自述：可能跟不上技術變化（含新興 AI 技術）與消費者期待變化；若未能預見技術趨勢或未投入適當資源，業務可能受損。
findings.excerpt: Our industry is subject to rapid technological change, and the demands and expectations of our consumers can change quickly. Predicting the changes that our consumers want, learning new technologies and developing new products and services can be complex, time-consuming and costly, and our investments in new innovations may not yield the expected business or financial benefits.

findings.claim: eBay 2026 年 1 月更新用戶協議，禁止未經授權的第三方 AI 代購（buy-for-me）代理下單；同時與 OpenAI 合作並測試自家 AI 購物代理。
findings.source: The Register: eBay updates legalese to ban AI-powered shop-bots
findings.excerpt: The company’s decision emerged in an update to its user agreement posted on January 20th, which insists users must not use “buy-for-me agents, LLM-driven bots, or any end-to-end flow that attempts to place orders without human review” on the site, unless eBay grants approval.

findings.claim: 分析師認為 OpenAI、Google、Perplexity 等 LLM 代理可能顛覆市集模式，市集可能淪為後端履約供應商。
findings.source: Retail Dive: How AI commerce threatens eBay, Amazon
findings.excerpt: For marketplaces like Amazon and eBay, the large language models that are moving swiftly into agentic commerce – including Perplexity AI, OpenAI and Google – are potentially disruptive to their model, said Adam Behrens, the CEO of New Generation.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋摘要未提供可逐字複製原文，agentic commerce 相關報導以 clues 保留。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
